title: MentalHealthBench tests AI across realistic support conversations
friendlyTitle: A new test checks how AI handles mental-health conversations
summary: OpenAI released an open benchmark built with more than 80 licensed mental-health experts across 22 countries. It evaluates responses across everyday stress, higher-acuity situations and emergencies, including whether models seek context, preserve agency and offer appropriate guidance.
friendlySummary: More than 80 licensed experts helped OpenAI build a test for AI replies about stress, serious concerns and emergencies. The test checks whether answers are safe, useful and respectful.
whyItMatters: People already bring sensitive personal questions to AI, so measuring more than crisis refusal is useful. The benchmark gives researchers a shared way to test helpfulness and safety, while OpenAI stresses that chatbots are not substitutes for professional care.
friendlyWhyItMatters: People use AI for personal support, so these answers need careful testing. AI can help, but it does not replace a trained professional.
